title: Universe screen live-call authorization (v0.1, cohort-scoped)
description: One separately granted permission for one live screen run (ADR-109). The extraction contract live_call_authorization@0.2.0 is contractually unusable here - its stage enum is closed to the three extraction stages and its scope is one company - so this narrow successor exists instead, scoped to the screen cohort. A screen live authorization binds, in one hash-bound artifact chain: the packet cohort (packet_manifest_sha256), the selected rows or full-cohort mode (selection_artifact_sha256, selection_kind), the prompt bytes (prompt_template_sha256, the SHA-256 of the exact committed screen template), the provider client contract (canonical contract digest), the enablement (reference plus sha), the endpoints (allowlist equality across connector, authorization and enablement), the model route, and the caps and budgets (logical, attempt, external, token, cost, wall-clock). A run under different packets, a different selection, different prompt bytes, a different contract, different endpoints, or different caps is a different authorization and is refused before a run directory, an SDK import, credential resolution, or any network send exists. Runtime-only: this artifact is never committed to source control; the Vertex project and every concrete budget live only here. The canary arithmetic is schema-pinned: a canary_100 authorization carries exactly 100 logical requests, 300 provider attempts and 400 external requests, and only the controlled_pilot rollout state; a full_cohort authorization requires release_or_research_production. Pricing is not a field: cost arithmetic is the committed exact-integer rule the extraction stack already carries.

packet_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact v0.5 packet manifest bytes this authorization covers. Verified at preflight against the manifest actually loaded and against the selection artifact's own binding.

prompt_template_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact committed prompts/discovery/universe_high_recall_screen.md bytes. Verified at preflight against the current committed bytes, before run-directory creation, SDK factory, ADC resolution, or any network; recorded again in the v0.2 screen manifest.

provider_client_contract_sha256.description: The canonical client-contract digest, recomputed at preflight from the connector's own declared contract for the authorized project and location. Must equal the enablement's value.

logical_request_cap.description: One logical request per selected valid packet, exactly. Stated, never discovered.

provider_attempt_cap.description: logical_request_cap times the 3-attempt generate ceiling of the committed retry policy.

budget_max_external_requests.description: logical_request_cap times the structural per-row maximum of one countTokens send plus three generate attempts.
